entry.title: New: Bill 161 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Bill 161 withdrawn by introducer - 06/19/24
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 19, ARTICLE 11, SECTION 19-90 OF THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAXES

Expands permitted uses of Residential Tier Two Property tax revenue to include the funding of County-sponsored programs designed to address mental health.

Latest action: Council: Bill 161 withdrawn by introducer - 06/19/24
